notes.title: Cosmonautica Update 1.2.1 (What's up?)
notes.content:
[img]http://www.chasing-carrots.com/images/Update.jpg[/img]

Hello fellow Cosmonauticans,

we're back with a few small changes which should help regarding some crashes and other problems.

Right now we're working on a new project and therefore not full time on Cosmonautica. A bigger update would require a lot of evaluation and maybe re-designing of certain things. Time we really don't have right now, since we're a small team.

So for now we will make small changes here and there from time to time and then we'll see how we can improve more in the future.
Still, we're not turning our backs and just let this go as you can see. But we hope you can understand our side.

If you have any questions, feel free to write us an e-mail or here in the Cosmonautica Steam forums.

[list]
[*]The problem with the 2nd and 3rd skill in the task assignment screen got fixed
[*]Fixed the ‘Endangered Species’ mission, it can now be successfully finished
[*]A small bug in the campaign, chapter ‘N1L’s origin’ is also fixed
[*]Locked skills can no longer be previewed via the ?-buttons in the promotion popup
[*]Removed the ‘Loot ammo’ button and ammunition sliders from the loot interface
[*]Finishing a research in hyper travel no longer gives you the option to go to the research lab, which might be causing crashes on some machines
[/list]

Have fun with the new update and please post us your feedback, we're still reading and checking up on you. Thank you very much for your support :) 

Your Chasing Carrots
Dominik, Patrick, Daniel, Patrick, Markus and Josef

notes.title: Cosmonautica Update 1.2.0 (game changer)
notes.content:
[img]http://www.chasing-carrots.com/images/Update.jpg[/img]

Hello fellow Cosmonauticans, 

sorry that it took us longer than expected. This new update 1.2.0 brings you lots of meaningful changes and updates. We enhanced the game with some comfort features like quest markers, a passenger display and so on. Also we tweaked and re-balanced lots of stuff around the moral and need system.

What does that mean for the game? Well, some features will make more sense and it's more like the way these features were intended in the first place. But the game will get a bit harder with that, but only if you don't take care of your crew ;)

You will experience that your crew or some crew members are going to lose it, but you can handle every situation with the new and current features like the new bonus button, or by just removing all work shifts and so on.

So we would advise that you start this with a fresh game and a fresh mindset :) and if there are any questions, just let us know in the forums.

Now check out what's going on in this update:

[h1] NEW [/h1]
[list]
[*]Death ceremony for passed away crew members
[*]3 new interstellar quests
[*]3 new random events
[*]“Morale Info” in the clipboard
[*]Clipboard bonus button - gives crew members a moral boost for a limited time 
[*]Quest markers in galaxy view
[*]Kitchen and Medibay robot-upgrade does not replace cooks and doctors in your crew anymore and their assisting output when working alone is reduced.
[/list]

[h1] FIXES/CHANGES [/h1]
[list]
[*]Several crashes connected to achievements, job agency and crew needs
[*]Switched crew member needs fitness and entertainment
[*]Pirates do not attack anymore if you are close to your destination planet
[*]Crew members will not leave workstations during fights if the player does not order them to.
[*]Crew members stay longer on their stations during flight even with urgent needs.
[*]Fixed permanent shield exploit
[*]Fixed issues with hacking during fights and we improved the hacking AI
[*]Passenger seats are displayed alongside the cargo stock info
[*]Tooltips Merchant (Import/Export Traits)
[*]Sell goods to a merchant when his stock is already full is now possible
[*]Neutral goods are now getting slowly consumed by stations, too
[*]Correct display of crew level via N.O.D.E.
[*]Color coded “Morale Tooltip/Morale Info”
[*]“Research Finished” tooltips show unlocked technologies and we improved filtering of the room research
[*]Removed the customs cop from the Cataport 
[*]Visuals of crew states (sick, on fire and on strike) are retriggered after loading the game. 
[*]Fixed some problems with the tutorial popups
[*]Socializing is automatically aborted when a space fight starts
[*]Correct highlighting of preferences in in N.O.D.E crew tab
[*]UI Icon of Administrative Systems is now the correct one
[/list]

[h1] BALANCING [/h1]
[list]
[*]Smuggling mechanic
[*]Science effort for galaxy research reduced and increased science effort for technology
[*]Sickness probability and duration
[*]Balanced moral and needs
[*]Reduced max. number of specials per crew member to 4
[*]Dirt and damage done by crew and passengers 
[*]Cleaning and repair done by crewmembers and robots
[*]Crew member relationships
[/list]

Have fun with this update and please post us your feedback in the forums. Thank you very much :) 

Your Chasing Carrots 
Dominik, Patrick, Daniel, Patrick, Markus and Josef

[img]http://www.chasing-carrots.com/images/UpdateFooter.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Cosmonautica Update 1.1.9 (fixing and preparing)
notes.content:
[img]http://www.chasing-carrots.com/images/Update.jpg[/img]

Hey fellow [b]Cosmonauticans[/b],

this update should fix some campaign related crashes and some issues with passengers.

Alongside this patch we're also preparing and planning the next big update 1.2. which will be ready in a few weeks. 
We're trying to integrate as much feedback and suggestions as possible into the next update.

And better late than never: Cosmonautica is 15% off for the next 7 days (since the launch discount wasn't triggered).

[b]FIXES[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fixed crashes during travelling to campaign-related solar systems (eg. Yike System, Bloom C)
[*] Fixed final fight: Mission descriptions now specifically advises to prepare for combat. Save games being stuck right before the unresolvable fight will be set back one step. Both final enemies are better balanced and now won’t flee anymore.
[*] Fixed problem that the campaign mission won’t be removed from the N.O.D.E. after completion, which caused N1L’s messages to continue and prevented the Campaign achievement from being triggered.
[*] Fixed issue that caused the game to crash upon arrival on planet Suprafoam in campaign chapter V.
[*] Fixed invisible passengers
[*] Fixed passengers doing no damage and dirt to their cabin.
[*] Fixed crash when passenger cabin breaks
[*] Passengers will warn you and leave your ship, if there is too much dirt or damage and if they do not get enough food.
[*] Improved hacking efficiency of the navigation systems.
[/list]

Enjoy the game and as always post us your feedback in the forums. Thanks a lot :)

Your Chasing Carrots 
Dominik, Patrick, Daniel, Patrick, Markus and Josef

[img]http://www.chasing-carrots.com/images/UpdateFooter.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Cosmonautica Update 1.1.8 (the late one - aka we're still here)
notes.content:
[img]http://www.chasing-carrots.com/images/Update.jpg[/img]

Hi fellow Cosmonauticans,

first of all you may rest assured that we're still here and updating and enhancing the game. We always said that we're not going to abandon our game, it just took us some time to get working on it again in a proper way after gamescom and some needed vacation time.

So we put lots of effort into fixing crashes and optimize the game here and there. We also added new missions and we're planning a new update as you read these lines.

CHANGES in Cosmonautica:
[list]
[*] 23 new missions have been added
[*] After starting a travel, the view remains on the solar map
[*] Rhys Fenrize and Commodore Punkkore now fly individual ships in combat 
[*] Added touch-scroll for lists
[*] Optimized data exchange UI<>Code to improve performance
[/list]

FIXES:
[list]
[*] Enemies offering money via diplomacy in space fights too quickly or not suiting the situation
[*] Crew tooltips in the Russian localization only showed white squares
[*] Outdated enemy ships in the campaign didn’t get removed properly, thus stopping progress
[*] Bugs in several old missions
[*] Bighead achievement didn’t trigger
[*] Captain’s portraits on the solar map didn’t match the portraits in the diplomacy window
[*] Continue interception route of Ship after player got intercepted by another ship
[*] Invincible enemies or no diplomacy possible during space fights
[*] A bunch of small text revisions in the German localization
[*] Toilet and party room animation bugs for selected upgrades
[*] You can now easily escape the first encounter with Rhys Fenrize (campaign)
[*] Reordering of crewportraits now working on high resolutions
[*] Info panel glitch with planets that have a secret society trait
[*] Display of 2nd room upgrade now works correctly in the research tab
[*] Sticking of tasks, while dragging and pressing the right mouse button
[*] Jobscout search options will be resetted to default values when arriving on a different planet
[*] Mousewheel sensitivity tweaked in the merchant UI
[*] Various small UI tweaks
[*] Research time was showing infinite when player had a scientist but did not put him in a shift
[*] Crash connected to transporting passengers
[*] Crash when a pirate was selected in UI and was removed by trade system logic
[*] Crash connected to upgrading from older savegames
[*] Crashes connected to the job board, hiring and using the job scout
[*] Game freeze at the beginning of the campaign
[*] Several fixes of the campaign scripts preventing the storyline from progressing 
[*] Optimization of campaign scripts to prevent crashes
[*] Fixes on several missions
[/list]

BALANCING:
[list]
[*] Adjustments of rewards, penalties and deadlines for several missions (ongoing)
[*] Adjustments of the evasive maneuver effect for all ships in space fights
[*] A basic party room now satisfies additional to entertainment needs, fitness needs (while crew members are dancing) and food needs (while crew members are sitting)
[/list]

Have fun playing, enjoy your weekend and leave us a message if you have any problems :)
And please share your love & awesomeness and leave us a review.

Your Chasing Carrots 
Dominik, Patrick, Daniel, Patrick, Markus and Josef

[img]http://www.chasing-carrots.com/images/UpdateFooter.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Cosmonautica Update 1.1.6 - Out of Early Access
notes.content:
[img]http://www.chasing-carrots.com/images/Update.jpg[/img]

Hello fellow space captains,

today is an cosmonawesome day! After over two years of development, our small team has finally breached the final frontier - Cosmonautica has left Early Access. Over the course of the past months, we brain-stormed, created, improved, overhauled, fixed, discussed, cut, risked and strived hard to follow our vision of a space trading simulation of its own kind.

Needless to say, that without you as a community, Cosmonautica would not be the game it is now. We know, however, that there's still room to improve. Not only stability-wise, but also regarding future contents, we won't stop working on our little baby, so we can give you the best possible experience for your adventures in space.

That said, we appreciate your feedback very much, be it questions, ideas or any bugs you find. So feel free to get in touch, and let us know what you think.

By the way, we'll be at the Gamescom in Cologne, Germany, next week. Should you happen to be there, come and visit us in Hall 10.1, Booth A050 - B051, at the Indie Arena Booth. We're looking forward to meeting you.

Thank you for your great support and have fun playing Cosmonautica!

Your Chasing Carrots
Dominik, Patrick, Daniel, Patrick, Markus and Josef



Please note: unfortunately, the launch discount has not been activated as of yet. We already contacted the Steam team about this issue, and we hope to resolve it as soon as possible.

[img]http://www.chasing-carrots.com/images/UpdateFooter.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.0.22 (balancing and polishing)
notes.content:
[img]http://www.chasing-carrots.com/images/Update.jpg[/img]

Hi fellow Cosmonauticans,

we're constantly improving the game and fixing lots of stuff. Right now our main focus is to deliver a great overall performance without huge bugs, but that doesn't mean we're leaving the game behind after we're out of Early Access. Thanks to you, our fellow space captains, we have gatherd lots of valuable and great ideas and merged them with our list for possible future content. Of course we'll have to see how things work out in general, but we see that there's a demand for things like mod support and so on.
Right now we're also preparing for our [b]gamescom 2015[/b] appearance and maybe we'll see some of you in Cologne :)

The final "out of Early Access" release for Cosmonautica will be July 31st and we hope you had lots of fun so far and also enjoyed the soundtrack.

So here's the list of what has been done during the last days:

CHANGES in Cosmonautica:
[list]
[*] New Intro/Startup screen
[*] GUI optimisations for 4:3 screen resolutions
[*] Achievement images
[*] Improved german translation 
[*] Popups for research tasks
[*] Reworked good icons
[*] New crewmember specials: Fumbler, Clutterer, Ascetic, Landsman
[*] Spacefight AI can use torpedos now, beware!
[*] Various bugfixes and balancing tweaks
[/list]

FIXES:
[list]
[*] Spaceflight related crashes when the enemy AI was in weapon reloading state at the end of your last fight
[*] Reduced planet rotation speed around the sun. No more angular travel trajectories. This fix works only for new Games.
[*] Length of translated texts
[*] N.O.D.E is closing when you get caught by a space cop
[*] Double clicking on a crew member won't change camera in hyper travel
[*] Smuggle UI localized
[*] The achievement “A True Cosmonaut” will now only be triggered at the end of the campaign.
[/list]

BALANCING:
[list]
[*] Reseach times
[*] Ship prices
[*] Ship repair prices
[*] Spacebattles in campaign
[/list]

Check it out and if you find some weird stuff, drop us a line ;)

Thanks and have fun playing,
your Chasing Carrots
Dominik, Patrick, Daniel, Patrick, Markus and Josef

[img]http://www.chasing-carrots.com/images/UpdateFooter.jpg[/img]

notes.content:

This is ongoing stuff we’re also working on and that will come with future updates:

notes.title: Update 1.0.17 (may the delay be with you)
notes.content:
[img]http://www.chasing-carrots.com/images/Update.jpg[/img]

Hey fellow space captains,

thanks a lot for your patience regarding this update. We are working on lots of fronts these weeks. This update was focused on the space fight, but there's still some stuff to be done and that leaves some room for improvement. We changed lots of stuff and prepared different game elements for our localisation purposes.

Also we've updated the game engine to its latest version, which was a necessary update regarding all platforms, especially the upcoming mobile versions of Cosmonautica. This update might increase the performance on some levels, but it's also possible that perfomance decreases.
If you experience performance issues of any kind, please let us know, because we're working towards leaving the Early Access stage. We want to improve the game experience, so that you can enjoy longer game sessions without crashes.

We still have lots of cool ideas floating around, but therefor this game has to be succesful for us.
Saying that does not mean that we're abandoning Cosmonautica after we're out of the Early Access stage. It simply means that we are now improving the current game, fix lots of bugs, balance some more and polish a lot. Then we have to evaluate what makes sense to add.

Right now we are aiming for leaving EA by the end of June and we are hoping for your support to spread the word about Cosmonautica and make this game the success we need in order to put out more content.

Have fun playing around with the current update and please report every weird thing you encounter.

Changes in Cosmonautica:
[list]
[*] Improved space fight AI
[*] New space fight interface
[*] Improved enemy generation
[*] Overhauled hacking
[*] Cannon redesigned (upgrade with area damage and emp)
[*] Diplomacy interface overhaul
[*] Now all tasks are possible during space fight (except research)
[*] After space fight the destiniation is still active
[*] Fixed issues regarding buying and saving ammunition 
[*] Lots of GUI bugfixes
[*] New FX: explosions and room effects
[*] Multitouch support
[*] Overhauled main menu
[*] Better usage of pill dispenser and medbay
[*] Fixed the drastic speed increase during the game
[*] Fixed the active shield problem after space fights
[*] Improved the notification system
[*] New victory and defeat screens
[*] Fixed crashes regarding research
[/list]

This is stuff we’re working on and that will come with future updates:
[list]
[*] Localisation 
[*] Reading enemy stats (Antenna interface and game design)
[*] Space station outside
[*] Improving the game for different resolutions
[*] Achievements
[*] Crew socializing
[*] Spacefight manouvers fixing
[*] Ingame menu
[*] Campaign implementation and testing
[*] More reliable interplanetary traveling algorithm
[*] New alien race
[/list]

Thanks a lot for understanding our last minute delays and giving us so much valuable input. We really appreciate your feedback. :)
Keep up your great support and help us make this the game you and we want to play for a long time.


Kind regards
your Chasing Carrots

[img]http://www.chasing-carrots.com/images/UpdateFooter.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.0.15 (frames and ships)
notes.content:
[img]http://www.chasing-carrots.com/images/UpdateFebruary2015.jpg[/img]
Ahoy fellow [b]Cosmonauticans[/b],

today we would like to serve you some stable frames accompanied with some fresh ships and garnished with some fine bugfixes and changes. Enjoy! :)

With this update you get four new ships and we got rid of a huge performance issue. In general we tried to optimize the performance as much as possible.
The interstellar quests are still a work in progress, but in the upcoming days we will give you a sneak peek with a first and newly designed interstellar mission instead of the previous wedding mission.

[u]This has changed in Cosmonautica[/u]:
[list]
[*] Performance issues/fps drops fixed
[*] New Cruiser ship level III “Stingrace”
[*] New Raider ship level II “Jellytox”
[*] New Raider ship level III “Sharkalon”
[*] New Cargo ship level II “Manatide”
[*] Now you can find the salary of your crew members on their crew tab
[*] Promoting a crew member to level 10 won’t crash the game
[*] Space fight crashes fixed
[*] More tooltips (import/export)
[*] Redesigned lootinterface
[*] Redesigned Crew Stats UI (health and morale are more prominent)
[*] Merchant fixes (slider, icons)
[*] A new animation system is in place (better performance, less glitchy)
[*] Better results using the job scout function
[*] Fixed crewportraits (frozen states, no portrait after loading)
[*] A newly bought ship will not carry over the stats of the old ship anymore
[*] Fixed graphical issues in the crew statusbar
[*] Ammunition sliders in the shipyards are working reliably
[*] Room status in the shipyard is displayed correct now
[*] Redesigned “Emptyroom”
[*] Illegal goods are now displayed in the Travel UI
[*] Fixed crashes on smuggle failure
[*] Decreased researchtime for solar rings and solar systems
[*] Fixed selling a ship will automatically sell your ammunition
[/list]

[u]This is stuff we’re working on and that will come with the next updates[/u]:
[list]
[*] Energy rooms (game design done)
[*] Techtree (in progress)
[*] Campaign (writing process)
[*] Redesigning the needs and skill systems
[*] Solar map quest marker
[*] Better finance informations
[*] More differences between solarsystems
[*] The new “Dangerfreaks Quest” gives you a sneak peek at the upcoming interstellar quests
[/list]

As you can see we've included lots of your valuable feedback and we hope you have a lot of fun with this update. Keep your comments, reports and suggestions coming, we really appreciate your support and together we're going strong towards the final release.

Kind regards
your Chasing Carrots

[img]http://www.chasing-carrots.com/images/UpdateFooter.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.0.12 (personality, please)
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow Cosmonauts, and welcome to our next update.

To spice up life on board, we've put some emphasis on crewmember improvements and reworked the passenger system, amongst other things. Let us introduce what's new...
 
Features and Improvements:
[list]
[*] Crewmembers get special perks, which influence their behavior positively and/or negatively
[*] Promoting crewmembers allows you to spend one skillpoint freely to improve their abilities
[*] Distinct states for crewmembers have been added, such as euphoria and strike, that affect their workflow
[*] Your crewmembers can progress up to experience level 10, instead of 5 levels
[*] The crew interface for the joboffice and N.O.D.E has been overhauled.
[*] The jobscout offers up to 5 applicants, fitting your job description more or less exactly.
[*] Passengers now also show their emotions through thought bubbles.
[*]Passengers will leave your ship if they don’t feel comfortable, due to dirt, broken stuff or hunger. 
[*] Passengers got a couple of new clothing textures, depending on the mission they appear in.
[*] Pirates are now less aggressive and won’t attack you in close vicinity to planets. 
[*] Pirates choose to attack you, depending on your current weapons, cargo and passengers.
[*] Space stations offer an increased amount of missions to choose from.
[*] Balanced economy elements enable more profit for trading players.
[/list]

Note: Due to the changes in the passenger system, active passenger missions in your savegames will be discarded. Also the skill levels of your saved crewmembers might be different.

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Old savegames with stuck passengers can now be fixed by reloading them. If you should ever get passengers who do not disappear after finishing a mission, they will be removed after saving the game and reloading it.
[*] Passengers board your ship with randomized needs, so they won't go to the toilet at the same time altogether.
[/list]

Enjoy this update and keep on supporting Cosmonautica by sharing your ideas, questions and concerns. Your feedback is of great value and we're looking forward to it.

Thank you!
Your Chasing Carrots

notes.title: Update 1.0.11 (time is money)
notes.content:
Ahoy me space hearties,

first of all Cosmonautica is nominated for the German Developer Award 2014. We're pretty excited and are looking forward to the award show in Cologne.

Next up just a little reminder for our [url=http://www.cosmonautica.com/blog/]dev blog[/url], where we'll put more stuff and give you more insights over time ;)

Now to the important part, the update:

You could see it already, but it wasn't ready with the last update. Now you are able to choose the uniforms of your crew members and you can give your ship a name!
So here's the complete list of what made it into this update:
[list]
[*] Customizable ship name (limited to 16 characters)
[*] Choose predefined uniforms for your crew
[*] Thought bubbles above your crewmembers describing their current mood / needs
[*] Take loans in the NODE interface under “finances”
[*] New ship: A massive and pricey cargo freighter awaits you in the shipyard
[/list]
Besides smaller bugfixes, this are the improvements in this update:
[list]
[*] Time runs slower at spacestations and faster in fastforward now
[*] Improved scripting functionality for quest and random events
[*] If you cancel a mission and have a second with the same name the second one will not be canceled, too
[*] Selection of crewmembers and rooms in your ship has been improved
[*] Now the pirate ship is accessible in all game modes in all shipyards in the second and third ring
[/list]

Leave us some feedback in the comments or in the Steam discussion boards. We really appreciate your input and value your opinions. Enjoy this update and please spread the word about Cosmonautica :)

Your Chasing Carrots
